北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京雾气浓，出行请注意交通安全，早晚添衣哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is foggy. Please drive safely and dress warmly in the morning and evening!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波阳光正好，湿度略高，多喝水，祝您一天愉快！
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo is sunny and a bit humid. Stay hydrated and have a great day!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴好，气温适中，愿您拥有愉快的一天！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and pleasant. Wishing you a wonderful day!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州雾气重，湿度大，请注意交通安全，保持舒爽。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is foggy and humid. Please drive safely and stay comfortable.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳今天阴天，体感微热，注意补充水分，保持好心情。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is overcast and warm. Stay hydrated and keep a good mood.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云，气温宜人。出门散步，享受惬意时光吧！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and pleasant. Go for a walk and enjoy the relaxing time!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京雾气朦胧，湿度 99%，出行务必注意安全。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is foggy with 99% humidity. Please take extra care when going out.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，湿度 100%，出门带伞，注意防潮哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast with 100% humidity. Bring an umbrella and mind the dampness.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉雾气弥漫，湿度 99%，出行请务必小心驾驶。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy with 99% humidity. Please drive very carefully when out.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，湿度高，微凉。记得添衣，保持温暖。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast, humid, and slightly cool. Remember to add a layer and stay warm.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，风力 3 级，湿度高。出门注意防风防潮。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast with moderate wind and high humidity. Be mindful of wind and dampness.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 4℃，很冷哦！请务必多穿衣物保暖。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like 4℃, very cold! Please dress warmly to stay cozy.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳雾气蒙蒙，体感 9℃，湿度 100%。出行注意安全，多穿衣。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is foggy, feels like 9℃, and 100% humid. Drive safely and dress warmly.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光正好，但体感 14℃，略有凉意。记得添衣哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny, but feels like 14℃, a bit cool. Remember to add a layer!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，风力 4 级。请注意防风，享受海滨风情。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy with 4-level wind. Please mind the wind and enjoy the seaside.
厦门.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛雾气重，风力 4 级。出行注意安全，做好防风措施。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy with 4-level wind. Drive safely and take precautions against the wind.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 15℃，风力 4 级。记得防风添衣哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels like 15℃ with 4-level wind. Remember to dress warmly and mind the wind.

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦雾气较重，体感热，湿度高。请注意交通安全。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is quite foggy, feels warm and humid. Please drive safely.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阳光正好，湿度略高，多喝水，享受这舒适一天！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny and humid. Stay hydrated and enjoy this comfortable day!
